components.name: popup

states.FORM: settings form visible; may hold unsaved edits
states.CONFIRM1: 'Are you sure?' with an active Yes button
states.CONFIRM2: 'Really sure?' with an active Yes button

transitions: the blocking switch returns to the stored value; typed accounts are kept and marked 'Not saved yet'
countdown cancelled; switch returns to stored value, typed accounts kept
the loosened settings are stored, exactly once
nothing stored; switch returns to stored value, typed accounts kept
nothing stored; no progress is remembered
open, before saved settings have loaded
checkbox, text box and Save are all visibly disabled until they load; if they cannot be read, a message says so
click on Save / Yes / Keep blocking within 0.6 s of a switch between form and gate (or of the Yes button unlocking)
ignored, and the buttons are visibly dimmed for that moment
edit so the form differs from what is stored
'Not saved yet' shows until saved or reverted
save with an entry that cannot be an account name
nothing stored, no gate; message names the bad entry
save, storage read or write fails or never answers
red message says it could not be read / saved
open while the current X tab has no blocker in it (opened before install or update)
banner explains and offers 'Reload this tab'
title tells the user to keep the popup open
invariants: A loosening is stored only by CONFIRM2.yes, never sooner than 15 s after CONFIRM1.yes. 'Loosening' is judged against what is in storage at the moment Save is pressed, not against this popup's earlier copy
Loosening = blocking turned off, or a handle added to the allowlist; anything else saves instantly
tick then untick the box, then save = no gate and no change
After keep blocking, starting again gives a full fresh gate (full 15 s)
save pressed twice = same result as once

CONFIRM2 shows the two buttons in swapped positions, and the message text is identical in CONFIRM1, WAIT and CONFIRM2 so nothing shifts: tapping one spot repeatedly through the wait ends on 'keep blocking', never on the final yes
The 15 s is measured on a monotonic clock; changing the device clock does not shorten it
Double click on Save [loosening] ends in CONFIRM1, not WAIT
Double click on the final yes stores once and ends in FORM with nothing further triggered
If the write to storage fails, the popup does not treat the change as saved
Opening the gate always cancels any countdown still running from an earlier one
Account entries accept @name, name or a profile link, are stored lower-case without @, and anything else is refused with a message

components.name: video on an X page

states.FREE: the extension does nothing to it; X is in full control, exactly as if the extension were not installed
states.BLOCKED_UNKNOWN: hidden, paused, overlay says the account could not be verified
states.BLOCKED_KNOWN: hidden, paused, overlay names the non-followed account

components.allowed_when: blocking is off OR it is a GIF OR author is followed OR author is me OR author is on the allowlist OR it belongs to the one post that has a live one-time pass and is shown on that post's own page
components.initial: A new video is blocked no later than its first play attempt or the next scan (next frame, or within 250 ms in a hidden tab), unless already known to be allowed (fail closed)
transitions: overlay gone; muted, autoplay and the box's inline position are as they were before the block; it stays paused until X or the user plays it
BLOCKED_KNOWN, or BLOCKED_UNKNOWN if the author is not known
paused and hidden; in a background tab within 250 ms
play attempt by page or user
the tap is stopped at the overlay in the bubble phase for click/pointer/touch/mouse events, so X's ordinary handlers never run: no navigation, no media viewer
one new tab; a second tap within 1.5 s opens nothing more; the X page itself does not navigate or start playing
tap 'Play in new tab' when there is neither a direct file nor a post id
no tab; overlay says it can't be opened, and keeps saying so until a file or post id for it becomes known, when it returns to the normal message
X removes or swaps the <video> element
no orphan overlay left; the button acts on the current element
(addition) the Play button pulses once, so the tap is visibly acknowledged
tap 'Play in new tab', tab could not be created
overlay says so and the button works again at once
tap 'Play in new tab' on a page that outlived an extension update
overlay says to reload the page
tap 'Play in new tab' succeeds after an earlier failure note
the note is replaced by the normal message
user presses X's Follow on the author
uncovered without a reload (depends on X's follow reply naming the account; unverified live)
user presses X's Unfollow on the author
only the button is shown, smaller
finger lands on the cover and drags vertically
the page scrolls exactly as it does anywhere else; X never sees the movement
finger lands on the cover and drags sideways
X gets the movement as usual (photo carousels, media viewer)
invariants: FREE -> BLOCKED -> FREE: the only differences from an untouched video are that it is paused and carries the same data-xvg=ok marker every checked video carries
Settings changes reach open X tabs without a reload
A blocked video never produces picture or sound on the X page
FREE -> BLOCKED -> FREE restores muted, autoplay and the box's inline position; playback itself is left paused for X to resume
While nothing changes on the page, the extension does no repeated work (no per-frame rescans)
The double-tap guard is per video: tapping Play on one video never deadens another video's button
Two videos sharing one container: freeing one never uncovers the other
Once an author is known to be followed, a later data record for the same media and same author that lacks the follow flag does not block it

components.name: player tab

states.PLAYING(q): the one video, at quality q, no feed around it
states.EXPIRED: message that the link has expired

components.initial: PLAYING(best) if the stored link exists, else EXPIRED
transitions: works for at least a day; the stored link is removed by the first clean-up that runs after 24 h
two quality switches before the first has loaded
position and play/pause state are those from before the first switch
falls to the next quality; with none left, a message says it couldn't be loaded
'Still loading' notice until it moves again
invariants: No path from the player tab to another video
If X gave no direct file, the tap opens the post page with a pass for the videos of that one post only, lasting 15 minutes
Stored player links older than a day are cleaned whenever a video is opened, not only at browser start

accepted_gaps: The one-time pass (fallback when X gives no direct file) is a single global slot: opening a second fallback video revokes the first; within 15 min it also applies in other tabs showing that same post, and to a video with no known author inside a quote card on that post's page
Caches of who-posted-what grow for the life of the tab
A pass that expires while its video is playing does not stop it at that instant; it is re-blocked at the next scan
If X's data names two different authors for the same media (a repost), the one processed last wins
Whether X has capture-phase tap handlers that still see taps on the overlay is not checked on the logged-in app

A video that is not inside a post (own upload preview, DMs) is covered as 'not verified' and may have nothing to open; we keep failing closed because the full-screen swipe viewer is not inside a post either
When X gives no direct file, Play opens the X post page (not the bare player) and the video is covered again after 15 minutes
Edits are lost if the popup is dismissed without saving; the 'Not saved yet' hint is the only warning
The stale-tab banner, the Follow/Unfollow hook and the two Play-button failure messages are not verified in a live browser
The reload banner for a tab opened before install appears only in the popup, and only for the front tab
A stored allowlist entry that the current rules reject must be deleted by hand before Save works; the message names it
Leaving the popup during the wait cancels it (the title says to keep it open); taps at the end of the wait land on 'Keep blocking' by design
Follow changes made in another tab or app are picked up only when X sends fresh data or the page reloads
Account names on one line separated by spaces are refused; one per line or comma-separated

Real finger scrolling cannot be driven in the test browser (Chrome ignores synthetic touch gestures there); it is verified at the event level only: no touch from a cover reaches X's listeners and nothing cancels it
In X's full-screen vertical video viewer, an upward swipe that starts on a covered video does not advance to the next one; the viewer's close/back still works
rule: Every user action in every state has an outcome the user can SEE. 'Nothing happens' alone is never acceptable: the control looks inactive, or it says why, or it is a bug.
